text: Two refinements of D-0237 from #357's last review. A watcher back in a later tenure whose agent run gave no result, or whose provider stopped it, ends the run's step once it has recorded why the provider stopped it, in the record beside the run's ref, where it did: it posts nothing, and its next step says the build stopped, quoting that record, unless a later post answered or replaced the build. Before, the old step tried the stopped post and was refused for its tenure. And a push of the lease whose answer was lost, and which lands only once the watcher's next push is refused as moved, is still the watcher's own: the watcher keeps what it tried through that refusal, so it adopts the lease that says so and starts no false tenure.
